requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Lexical ambiguity regarding 'dial tone' resolved by business rule CST-01. Requirement rewritten to specify the simultaneous generation of 350 Hz and 440 Hz signals and structured as a single functional requirement.

fields.object: the audible signal consisting of simultaneous 350 Hz and 440 Hz tones

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall generate the audible signal consisting of simultaneous 350 Hz and 440 Hz tones.
structuring_notes: Ambiguity resolved: 'dial tone' interpreted as the specific audible signal defined in CST-01 (350 Hz and 440 Hz simultaneous tones). Original text 'Generate a dial tone' rewritten to be explicit.
